title: Preventive Maintenance of Road: Asphalt Overlay, Iloilo East Coast, Estancia Wharf RD
description: PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE OF ROAD: ASPHALT OVERLAY - ILOILO EAST COAST-ESTANCIA WHARF RD - K0182 + 167 - K0183 + 502
colour_meaning: Look first: an official warning record, or two signs of risk together.

reasons.title: A bidder has a reported link to an official or investigation
reasons.detail: IBC INTERNATIONAL BUILDERS CORPORATION: documented link to James "Jojo" Ang Jr. (House representative, Uswag Ilonggo party-list): ICI and DPWH recommended criminal and administrative cases to the Ombudsman against eight lawmakers whose or whose families' firms won DPWH contracts (about 1,300 projects, 2016-20 [recommended, 2025-11-26; as reported]
reasons.evidence: From the team's register of company–person links reported in the news or hearings. Reported, not proven.
checks: Read the source article; confirm the link is stated there, not inferred.
Look for an official document (SEC filing, COA report, Ombudsman complaint) that confirms it.

reasons.title: A bidder had a contract terminated before
reasons.detail: F. Gurrea Construction, Incorporated (winner): 1 of 100 earlier road contracts terminated; A.D. Pendon Construction & Supply, Inc.: 1 of 191 earlier road contracts terminated; Ibc International Builders Corporation: 8 of 453 earlier road contracts terminated; Unitec Builder, Incorporated: 1 of 23 earlier road contracts terminated
reasons.evidence: In past contracts, a winner with an earlier termination had about 2.1 times the odds of another; this held on 2023–2025 data.
checks: Open the terminated contracts listed under Bidders and see why they ended (COA report, DPWH order).
Check whether the firm with the termination record is the winner.

reasons.title: Citizen inspectors rated the winner's other work unsatisfactory
reasons.detail: F. GURREA CONSTRUCTION, INCORPORATED has 6 project(s) rated unsatisfactory by Bisto citizen site inspectors
reasons.evidence: From Bisto Proyekto volunteer site inspections.
checks: Open the inspections of the winner's other projects on bisto.ph.

tests.text: UNITEC BUILDER, INCORPORATED: 6% of its finished DPWH contracts were terminated (5%+ went with about 4x the odds of termination; not yet confirmed on recent years)

claude_note:
**Claude check (advice only):** Figures (1,335 m, ₱54.6M ABC, six bidders) match DPWH; the termination history is old (2017 and 2022) and the alert concerns a losing bidder whose news page could not be opened.
**Sources:** DPWH API confirms figures; news link could not open · **Suggested next step:** check the source by hand
